tldr: 週五崩跌2,953點後，市場焦點轉向國家隊能否穩住台股，法人看短線反彈上看46,000點。
13家上市金控上半年大賺4,408億元、年增逾一倍創同期新高，成為股災中少見亮點。
6月出口748.3億美元創最強6月、年增40.3%、連32紅，AI與晶片需求續撐外貿。
財政部放寬繼承、受贈房地出售的成本認定，減輕不少家庭稅負。
國際背景仍脆弱：美股費半陷熊市、台積電ADR下跌，油價因美伊衝突站上80美元，Netflix因財測疲弱重挫。

items.title_zh: 三大法人爆賣2,617億元 外資單日賣超1,890億改寫紀錄
items.title_en: Record institutional selling: foreigners dump NT$189 billion as three major groups offload NT$261.7 billion
items.summary_zh: 外資週五對台股單日賣超1,890.39億元，創史上最大單日賣超；三大法人合計賣超2,617億元同創新高。外資集中提款權值股，光台積電就變現約1,040億元。破紀錄的賣壓凸顯在全球避險與AI估值疑慮下，資金撤離科技高度集中市場之快，也讓內資與國家隊後續能否承接成為市場焦點。
items.summary_en: Foreign investors net sold a record NT$189.04 billion of Taiwan shares on Friday, the single largest daily foreign outflow ever, while the three major institutional groups combined offloaded NT$261.7 billion — also a record. TSMC bore the brunt, with roughly NT$104 billion cashed out. The scale of the outflow underscores how fast global risk-off and AI-valuation jitters can drain liquidity from a tech-heavy market, raising the stakes for domestic and state-linked buyers in the sessions ahead.

items.title_zh: 法人喊「快觸底」 短線反彈先看46K
items.title_en: Analysts say selloff is near a bottom, eye short-term rebound toward 46,000
items.summary_zh: 歷史性重挫拖累指數跌破季線後，部分法人認為盤勢已近底部，指數與均線乖離大幅擴大，跌深反彈機率轉高。法人點名，若反彈成形，先看46,000點；但強調量能須有效放大、站回關鍵均線，才能化解空方壓力。此一研判牽動內資新一週的布局節奏，市場關注國家隊護盤力道能否延續。
items.summary_en: After the historic plunge dragged the index below its quarterly moving average, some institutional analysts argue the market is approaching a bottom, with the bias-from-average correction now large enough to raise the odds of a technical bounce. They flag a first upside target near 46,000 if a rebound takes hold, while cautioning that turnover must expand and the index reclaim key averages to relieve selling pressure. The call matters because it frames how domestic buyers may position into the new week.

items.title_zh: 2026 AI記憶體新戰局：HBM4量產、SRAM異軍突起
items.title_en: 2026 AI-memory battle reshapes chip supply chain: HBM4 ramp and SRAM's rise
items.summary_zh: AI記憶體版圖在2026年進入新階段，HBM4量產將於SK海力士、三星、美光同步展開，打破過去單一供應商掌握高溢價的局面，輝達等AI晶片客戶議價能力可望提升。同時，低延遲SRAM因應AI推理需求崛起，與HBM形成互補。對台廠而言，先進封裝與記憶體相關供應鏈仍是AI資本支出題材核心，值得留意技術世代切換下的受惠名單與供需節奏。
items.summary_en: The AI memory landscape is shifting into a new phase in 2026, with HBM4 mass production set to begin across SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron — breaking the era of single-supplier premiums and improving pricing leverage for AI-chip customers such as Nvidia. At the same time, low-latency SRAM is emerging as a core spec for AI inference, complementing HBM. For Taiwan's supply chain, the shift keeps advanced packaging and memory-related names central to the AI capex story.

items.title_zh: 記憶體族群成國家隊救援清單 護盤鎖定台廠供應鏈
items.title_en: Memory names become the national team's rescue list as the market sinks
items.summary_zh: 指數暴跌之際，記憶體與封裝相關個股——南亞科、旺宏、聯電、南電等——浮上「國家隊」護盤名單，官股資金集中承接以緩和跌勢。此現象凸顯政策性資金在市場承壓時，優先鎖定結構重要的科技供應鏈個股；也讓投資人得以觀察官方視為穩盤支柱的次族群，作為新一週布局與觀察國家隊動向的參考指標。
items.summary_en: As the index cratered, memory and packaging-related stocks — Nanya Technology, Macronix, UMC, Nan Ya PCB and others — surfaced on the "national team" support list, with state-linked funds concentrating buying on these names to cushion the fall. The episode highlights how policy-linked buying targets structurally important tech supply-chain stocks during stress, and gives investors a read on which sub-sectors officials view as anchors for market stability heading into the new week.

items.title_zh: 史上最強上半年：13家金控賺4,408億元、年增逾一倍
items.title_en: Record first half: 13 financial holdings earn NT$440.8 billion, up over 100% year-on-year
items.summary_zh: 台灣13家上市金控上半年合計稅後淨利4,408億元，創同期新高、較去年同期倍增，銀行、保險、證券三大引擎全面開花。富邦金上半年獲利突破973.4億元、累計EPS居雙冠王，國泰金則為單月獲利王。亮眼成績單為股災提供防禦性對比，也強化金融股的股利吸引力，市場關注獲利動能能否延續至下半年與明年配息表現。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 13 listed financial holding companies posted a combined first-half net profit of NT$440.8 billion, a record for the period and more than double the year-earlier level, with banking, insurance and securities units all firing. Fubon Financial topped NT$97.3 billion to lead on cumulative EPS, while Cathay Financial was the single-month profit leader. The blockbuster results offer a defensive counterpoint to the equity rout and reinforce the sector's dividend appeal into 2027.

items.title_zh: 元大金、國票金半年賺贏去年整年 AI多頭挹注
items.title_en: Yuanta and IPCF book more than a full year's profit in just six months on AI-driven bull run
items.summary_zh: 受惠年初AI帶動的台股多頭行情，證券體質較重的金控如元大金、國票金上半年獲利即超越去年全年，自營、經紀與財管收入同步大增。法人認為，龐大的上半年獲利基期墊高明年配息想像空間；惟近期台股崩跌提醒，交易導向獲利具景氣循環性，對市場情緒急轉直下較為敏感，後續須觀察下半年動能與行情走向。
items.summary_en: Riding the AI-fuelled equity rally earlier in the year, securities-heavy holdings such as Yuanta Financial and IP Fund (國票金) earned more in the first half than in all of the prior full year, with trading, brokerage and wealth-management income surging. Analysts say the outsized first-half base sets up stronger dividend potential for next year, though the recent market crash is a reminder that trading-linked earnings are cyclical and sensitive to a sharp reversal in sentiment.

items.title_zh: 現金為王：高股息ETF七月除息季持續吸金
items.title_en: Cash-is-king: high-dividend ETFs keep drawing inflows into the July ex-dividend season
items.summary_zh: 台股劇烈震盪下，投資人轉向收益型商品，高股息ETF七月以來持續吸金：指標0056在7月前九日淨申購逾101億元，多檔主動式高息ETF亦各有逾10億淨申購。部分商品在七月除息潮打出雙位數年化配息率。資金流向顯示，以配息為核心、分散布局的ETF組合，正成為投資人在波動中穩健防禦的重要工具，惟仍須留意除息後填息與淨值波動風險。
items.summary_en: With the market whipsawing, investors leaned into income, and high-dividend ETFs kept attracting money through early July: the flagship 0056 drew over NT$10.1 billion in net subscriptions in the first nine days of the month, while several active high-yield ETFs each pulled in more than NT$1 billion. Some products advertise double-digit annualised yields into the July ex-dividend wave. The flows show how yield-focused, diversified ETF baskets are becoming a core defensive tool during volatility.

items.title_zh: 主動式ETF「主動第一金優股息」00408A掛牌 布局台積電、台達電
items.title_en: New active ETF "First-Trust Active Preferred Dividend" (00408A) lists, holding TSMC and Delta
items.summary_zh: 第一金投信主動式台股ETF「主動第一金優股息」（00408A）7月15日上市，並可辦理融資融券，持股33檔含台積電、台達電、廣達等。該基金採季配息，經理費0.75%、保管費0.035%。新掛牌擴充快速成長的主動式ETF陣容，為財富管理客戶提供更多主動選股、偏重配息的配置工具；在市場震盪、收益與下檔管理需求升溫下，此類產品受關注度提高，惟仍需評估主動選股績效與費用率。
items.summary_en: A new actively managed Taiwan-equity ETF, First Financial's Active Preferred Dividend (00408A), began trading on July 15 with margin and short-selling eligibility, holding 33 names including TSMC, Delta Electronics and Quanta. The quarterly-distributing fund carries a 0.75% management fee and 0.035% custody fee. The launch adds to a fast-growing menu of active ETFs, giving wealth clients more actively selected, dividend-oriented building blocks as demand for income and downside management rises amid choppy markets.

items.title_zh: 財政部放寬舊制繼承、受贈房屋出售成本認定
items.title_en: Finance Ministry eases cost-basis rules for selling inherited or gifted old-system homes
items.summary_zh: 財政部發布解釋令，個人出售以舊制取得的繼承或受贈房屋，其取得成本（繼承或受贈時的房屋評定現值與公告土地現值）可按取得日至出售日的消費者物價指數比例調整；調整後成本連同改良、移轉費用可自售價中減除，墊高成本、降低課稅所得。新令即日適用於尚未核課確定案件，對持有舊制房產的家庭形成實質減稅，後續留意各國稅局核課實務與必要單據留存。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance issued an interpretation letting individuals who sell inherited or gifted houses acquired under the old (pre-2016) tax system adjust the acquisition cost — the assessed house value and published land value at the time of inheritance or gift — by the consumer price index between the acquisition and sale dates. The inflation-adjusted cost, plus improvement and transfer expenses, is deducted from the sale price, raising the cost basis and reducing taxable gains. The ruling applies immediately to all un-adjudicated cases, easing the burden for many families.

items.title_zh: 連續繼承（受遺贈）房地 房地合一持有期間放寬合併計算
items.title_en: Holding-period rule relaxed for property acquired through successive inheritance
items.summary_zh: 財政部另放寬因「連續繼承或受遺贈」取得房地的房地合一稅持有期間計算，允許將前手持有期間合併計入。由於持有愈久適用稅率愈低，合併計算可使交易適用較低稅率級距、顯著降低稅負。此函釋降低繼承人的不確定性，與舊制房屋成本認定放寬相互呼應，減輕跨代持有不動產的移轉稅務壓力；實務上仍須備妥各次繼承的取得時點與相關文件以利適用。
items.summary_en: In a related move, the Ministry of Finance also relaxed how the holding period is calculated under the house-and-land (房地合一) capital-gains tax for property obtained through successive inheritance or bequest, allowing prior owners' holding periods to be counted together. Because the tax rate steps down the longer a property is held, aggregating the periods can push a sale into a lower rate band, materially cutting the tax due. The clarification reduces uncertainty for heirs and complements the eased cost-basis rule for old-system homes.

items.title_zh: 6月出口748.3億美元創最強6月、年增40.3%、連32紅
items.title_en: June exports hit a record-strong US$74.83 billion, up 40.3%, extending a 32-month winning streak
items.summary_zh: 台灣6月出口748.3億美元，創歷年最強6月、年增40.3%，連續第32個月正成長；上半年出口累計4,166.6億美元同創新高。電子零組件出口253.9億美元、年增32.8%，在台積電等半導體廠製程升級與擴產帶動下維持強勁。數據確認AI需求仍撐起出口引擎，惟官方關注成長能否從少數龍頭擴散至更完整供應鏈，以及下半年基期墊高後的續航力。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's June exports reached US$74.83 billion, the strongest June on record and up 40.3% year-on-year, marking a 32nd consecutive month of growth; first-half exports totalled US$416.66 billion, also a record. Electronic components exports rose to US$25.39 billion (+32.8%) as TSMC and other chipmakers ramped advanced-process capacity. The data confirm AI demand is still powering the export engine, even as officials watch whether growth can broaden beyond a handful of leaders.

items.title_zh: 經濟部邀半導體業者座談 因應美國擬對晶片加徵關稅
items.title_en: Economics ministry convenes chipmakers over looming US semiconductor tariffs
items.summary_zh: 面對美國研擬對半導體及晶片衍生品加徵關稅，經濟部邀集國內半導體公協會與主要業者（含台積電、聯電等）座談，評估潛在衝擊並研商因應。座談凸顯貿易政策仍是出口與晶片高度依賴經濟體的首要總經風險——即便台灣已爭取到15%對等關稅稅率。晶片專屬關稅的課徵方式與範圍，恐牽動未來數月供應鏈的投資與布局決策，值得持續追蹤談判進展。
items.summary_en: With Washington weighing additional tariffs on semiconductors and chip-derived products, Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs convened industry associations and leading firms — including TSMC and UMC — to discuss the potential impact and coordinate a response. The consultations underscore how trade policy remains a top macro risk for an export- and chip-dependent economy, even after Taiwan secured a 15% reciprocal-tariff rate. How any chip-specific levy is structured could shape supply-chain investment decisions in the months ahead.

items.title_zh: 美股費半陷熊市 SK海力士ADR崩逾13%、台積電ADR下跌
items.title_en: US chip gauge enters a bear market; SK Hynix ADR crashes 13%, TSMC ADR slips
items.summary_zh: 最近一個美股交易日，費城半導體指數重挫逾4%，創逾一年最大單週跌幅，較6月下旬歷史高點回落約20%、正式進入熊市，7月迄今已跌逾18%。SK海力士ADR崩跌逾13%、台積電ADR跌逾2%，AI估值偏高與美伊衝突推升油價的疑慮重創晶片股情緒。此波跌勢為亞洲科技股新一週定調偏空氛圍，市場關注台股開盤能否守穩，以及晶片股評價修正是否告一段落。
items.summary_en: In the latest US session, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell more than 4%, its worst weekly drop in over a year, and is now down about 20% from its late-June record — formally a bear market — after sliding more than 18% so far in July. SK Hynix's ADR crashed more than 13% and TSMC's ADR fell over 2%, as worries over stretched AI valuations and rising oil on US-Iran tension battered chip sentiment. The moves set a cautious tone for Asian tech into the new week.

items.title_zh: AI支出掀疑慮 美股道瓊跌406點、費半領跌
items.title_en: Wall Street falls as AI-spending doubts and Middle East risk hit sentiment
items.summary_zh: 美股收黑，投資人質疑龐大AI資本支出能否帶來足以支撐高估值的回報，道瓊下跌406點（-0.77%）、那斯達克跌1.40%、標普500跌1.01%。美伊衝突升溫推升油價，加深避險情緒。此波回檔顯示，一旦估值與地緣政治疑慮同時浮現，市場由AI主導的多頭結構可能迅速鬆動，使全球風險偏好在週末前維持脆弱，牽動下週台股與亞股走向，市場靜待7月底聯準會會議指引。
items.summary_en: US stocks closed lower as investors questioned whether massive AI capital spending can deliver returns big enough to justify lofty valuations, with the Dow off 406 points (-0.77%), the Nasdaq down 1.40% and the S&P 500 off 1.01%. Escalating US-Iran conflict, which lifted oil prices, added to the risk-off mood. The pullback shows how quickly the market's AI-led leadership can wobble when valuation and geopolitical worries surface together, keeping global risk appetite fragile into the weekend.

items.title_zh: 半導體賣壓擴大 拖累美股走低（2026-07-17）
items.title_en: Semiconductor selloff deepens, dragging Wall Street lower (2026-07-17)
items.summary_zh: 美股主要指數走低，半導體賣壓擴大，晶片族群寫下2025年4月以來最慘一週，代表性指數自高點回落約20%。中國AI新創Moonshot意外突破震撼該類股，加深AI估值偏高疑慮。晶片股領跌，並伴隨油價走高與Netflix雙位數重挫，使週末前市場風險情緒維持脆弱，投資人聚焦後續AI資本支出能否帶來相稱回報。
items.summary_en: US indices slid as a semiconductor selloff deepened, with the chip cohort posting its worst week since April 2025 and a key industry gauge sinking about 20% from its record. A surprise breakthrough from Chinese AI startup Moonshot jolted the sector, compounding worries over stretched AI valuations. Chips led broad losses alongside rising oil and a double-digit drop in Netflix, leaving risk sentiment fragile into the weekend.

items.title_zh: Netflix財報優於預期 股價仍重挫約12%（2026-07-17）
items.title_en: Netflix beats estimates but stock drops about 12% on soft guidance (2026-07-17)
items.summary_zh: Netflix第二季營收125.6億美元、年增13%，淨利34.0億美元、每股0.80美元，大致符合或略優於預期。但股價一度重挫12%、後收斂至約9%跌幅，主因第三季財測低於華爾街預期，且公司宣布將把用戶互動數據由半年一次改為一年僅公布一次，引發投資人疑慮，凸顯高評價成長股對財測不如預期的敏感度。
items.summary_en: Netflix reported Q2 revenue of US$12.56 billion, up 13% year-on-year, and net income of US$3.40 billion, or US$0.80 a share, roughly in line with or slightly ahead of expectations. Yet the stock fell as much as 12% before paring losses to around 9%, as third-quarter guidance came in below Wall Street forecasts and the company said it would report engagement data only once a year, unsettling investors.

items.title_zh: 油價站上80美元 美伊衝突威脅荷莫茲海峽（2026-07-17）
items.title_en: Oil tops US$80 as US-Iran conflict threatens the Strait of Hormuz (2026-07-17)
items.summary_zh: 國際油價站上每桶80美元、單週漲約13%，美伊衝突升溫再度點燃對荷莫茲海峽的憂慮——該海峽承載全球約兩成石油運輸。美方空襲與海峽油輪通行受阻，使能源市場維持風險溢價，能源類股逆勢走高，即便大盤下跌。油價走高加深通膨疑慮，使利率與風險性資產前景更趨複雜，成為市場關注焦點。
items.summary_en: Crude climbed above US$80 a barrel and gained roughly 13% over the week as escalating US-Iran hostilities revived fears over the Strait of Hormuz, which handles about a fifth of the world's oil. US strikes and disrupted tanker traffic through the strait kept a risk premium in energy markets, lifting energy shares even as the broader tape fell. Higher oil feeds inflation worries, complicating the outlook for rates and risk assets.

items.title_zh: 黃金避險光環轉淡 強勢美元與鷹派聯準會預期主導（2026-07-17）
items.title_en: Gold's safe-haven bid fades as hawkish Fed bets and a strong dollar dominate (2026-07-17)
items.summary_zh: 金價跌破每盎司4,000美元、單週下跌逾3%，即便美伊衝突升溫，仍因美元轉強與美債殖利率走高壓過傳統避險買盤。美國零售銷售強勁，強化聯準會將維持高利率的預期，對不孳息的黃金形成壓力。交易員將焦點轉向7月29日聯準會會議，尋找金價下一步方向的指引，凸顯利率與美元走勢對貴金屬的主導力道。
items.summary_en: Gold slipped below US$4,000 an ounce and fell more than 3% for the week, even as US-Iran tension escalated, because a stronger dollar and higher Treasury yields overwhelmed the usual safe-haven demand. Robust US retail sales reinforced expectations that the Federal Reserve will keep rates elevated, pressuring the non-yielding metal. Traders now look to the July 29 FOMC meeting for the next cue on gold's direction.
